limitations: No public borrower, supplier, authorization, or liquidator writer is supported.

rules: verify exact market tuple and authorization
refresh price but do not treat it as needed for supply
read fresh oracle datum and confidence/freshness status
require post-borrow health and available mUSDC liquidity
reconcile debt shares and receiver assets
assets input converts to shares down; shares input converts assets up
prove unhealthy at the same timestamp
apply exact incentive and rounding path
reconcile seized collateral, repaid assets, and any bad-debt write-down separately
